Hi all — thanks for the details, Alex. Below is our current posture and draft responses for the questionnaire. Happy to jump on a call with Maya to walk through.

SOC / Compliance: 
- Redwood holds a current SOC 2 Type II attestation (attached: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf). We also provide a DPA and can execute a BAA for customers with PHI.

Data retention & deletion (current defaults and options):
- Live customer data (user content & inference artifacts): default retention 90 days. Deletion requests from the customer trigger our delete pipeline; data is removed from live storage within 30 days.
- Logs and audit trails: default retention 365 days; we can extend to multi-year retention for customers that need it (add-on or contractual).
- Backups: backup snapshots are retained for disaster recovery and rotated on a 180-day schedule by default. Backups are immutable for the retention window; as a result, data marked for deletion from live systems may still exist in backups until the next rotation.

Deletion SLAs and options:
- Standard deletion SLA: remove from live systems within 30 days of a validated request.
- Backups: we can offer an option to restrict backup retention to 90 days for regulated customers, or to provide an exception process to scrub/segregate customer data from backups at additional cost. Complete eradication from all backups may take up to the configured backup TTL (default 180 days) unless a custom remediation is contracted.

Encryption & access controls:
- Data at rest and in transit is encrypted (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit).
- Role-based access controls and audit logging are enabled.

Next steps / questionnaire ownership:
- Attached: draft questionnaire responses (vendor_questionnaire_response-draft.pdf). Please review and let me know where you need additional evidence.
- I'll coordinate a short security call with Maya and Alex — propose Wed 3/4 or Thu 3/5 (PST) morning to walk through the attestation and backup/deletion details.

Let me know if you want us to tighten the backup TTL to 90 days for Amaya; we can produce a pricing/contract addendum if they need guaranteed shorter backup retention.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
